name: synthrt-main
description: SVS Synthesis Runtime Library, main line.

Deliberately not named synthrt: the shared overlay carries a port of that name pinned to the refactor line, which ds-editor-lite consumes, and a same-named port here would silently shadow it because this overlay is searched first.
